title: Employer Group Contracts Rate Manual: Rate Basis, Pooling and Dental-Vision Bundling
content:
Rates under Employer Group Contracts are composite four-tier rates in every Cascade Group Dental & Vision segment; the pooling of renewal rates and the discount for offering dental and vision together vary by segment.

## Segment entries

| Segment | Pooling level | Group's own claims experience affects renewal | Dental-vision bundle discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 2-19 | fully pooled | No | 0 percent |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 20-49 | fully pooled | No | 2 percent |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 50-99 | fully pooled | No | 3 percent |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 100-249 | blended | Yes | 3 percent |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 250-999 | experience rated | Yes | 4 percent |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 1000 Plus | experience rated | Yes | 5 percent |

## Entries common to every segment

| Entry | Value in all six segments |
|---|---|
| Rate basis | composite four-tier |
| Vision member-and-spouse ratio | 1.9 |
| Vision member-and-children ratio | 2.0 |
| Rounding | half up to the cent |

## Definitions

- **Rate basis, composite four-tier**: one rate per coverage tier for all employees. The four coverage tiers are member only, member and spouse, member and children, and family.
- **Pooling level**: how renewal rates are set, one of fully pooled, blended or experience rated.
- **Claims experience affects renewal (Yes)**: the group's own claims experience affects renewal.
- **Dental-vision bundle discount**: the integer percent off both rates when the group offers Cascade dental and vision together.
- **Vision member-and-spouse ratio**: the multiplier of the member-only vision rate giving the member-and-spouse vision rate.
- **Vision member-and-children ratio**: the multiplier of the member-only vision rate giving the member-and-children vision rate.
- **Rounding**: amounts are rounded half up to the cent.

## Bundle discount illustration (hypothetical rates)

A hypothetical group in the 50-99 segment offering both Cascade dental and vision, with a dental rate of 50.00 dollars and a vision rate of 10.00 dollars, has 3 percent taken off both: the dental rate becomes 48.50 dollars and the vision rate 9.70 dollars. In the 2-19 segment the bundle discount is 0 percent, so offering both changes neither rate.
